psram-initialization.title: NSS1 PSRAM session establishment and invalidation
steps: Reserve XPI, NSS1/GPIO29 and LUT 8..11; execute reconfiguration from SRAM
Read committed MEM rate; establish safe idle and device-select bias
Configure slot and commands; read device identity and enter QPI
Publish the 8 MiB ready session only after successful initialization
After clock/reset: invalidate assumptions and reinitialize before reuse
psram-initialization.note: Source-level ownership ordering; no measured initialization-time or device-rate guarantee.

rcu-transition.title: RCU clock transition and failure boundary
steps: Close new admissions and request client quiescence
Drain all accepted work; retain ownership if drain fails
Park on the safe source and prepare conservative divisors
Qualify the requested source, switch and publish committed rates
On failure: preserve diagnostics and follow the source/reset recovery contract

bindings.text: Idle, Drain, Park, Program, Unlock, Lock, Divide, Switch, Commit, Recover, WarmDrain

rcu-transition.note: Logical stages, not a cycle-duration diagram or permission to abandon accepted traffic.

crypto-initialization.title: Crypto initialization, operation and erasure lifecycle
steps: Keep PCLK running; wait for reset scrub and maintenance readiness
Load the CRYC1 constant image with required padding and checks
COMMIT; require READY, TABLE_VALID and TABLE_LOCKED
Configure key/operands and run the selected engine with owned buffers
Drain accepted DMA; ZEROIZE and observe actual scrub completion
crypto-initialization.note: API return and timeout do not establish engine, DMA or erasure completion.

ppalite-capture.title: Processed-frame ownership and publication
steps: Select PROCESS at a global idle barrier; validate source, layout and allocation
Configure DMA2 and source; ARM locks the matching job snapshot
Start DMA first, then DVP; consume every input pixel and pack selected rows
Stop DVP without flushing; wait for source epoch, pipeline and final DMA response drain
FINALIZE; require COMPLETE + RESULT_VALID before exposing a frame
RELEASE retains PROCESS; on failure abort/drain/isolate and RECOVER without releasing on timeout
ppalite-capture.note: Logical ordering only. Polling budgets are not elapsed-time guarantees; failed cleanup keeps ownership and buffer lifetime.
